Content: All energy will be produced locally by renewable resources (maybe solar and wind) - There will be more than enough to share with others.
Transportation takes place using clean energy sources, that honor and respect the environment and the people who live on the planet.
Local power that has been designed and built in our communities/ decentralized micro-grids that are climate resilient
We have embraced and rolled out renewable energy sources that are positively influencing lifestyles and the globe.
We have developed systems that bring us the things we need from our environment – where we get energy coincides with the way we get our food which is connected to how we build our homes.

Where do we get our energy? Getting rid of solar farms, having solar panels on our buildings and everywhere around us, instead of extending ourselves.Retracting, and taking less land and resources. Instead of streets, more green space to nurture whatever grows there naturally.

We have shifted away from the mining of fossil fuels and rely on a new mode of energy production that relies solely on renewable sources that create byproducts of oxygen or water (anything that is neutral or positive for the continued thriving of the Earth).

Extractive industries are only part of the past, as now energy creation and development is sustainable and does not harm the people or the plants and animals. There are enough minerals and resources that existed after the collapse that there is no need for more extraction.
Solar, water, and wind are common sources of power and energy.
We primarily use solar energy and other renewable energy.

With a changed climate, solar power would be more difficult to harness and the technology requires more elaborate production anyway. With more severe weather events, including storms, wind would be a prime provider for power, but it depends on the ways we can store energy then for future use, like pumping water to higher elevations to use later.
We have learned to use sun power to build Star Trek-style transporters so we can travel with no need for airplanes/cars

We’ve come a long way with harnessing the energy. We’ve harnessed the energy of the sun to float where we need to go with big balloons instead of planes. It takes a while to get where we’re going but we aren’t destroying the environment.
Only regenerative energy sources.
There are cities filled with solor arrays and families have shared clean energy and homes that are energy efficient.
Our homes and every day life consume only the energy available.

Date/Circle Name: 10/30/25 Kailua, HI Polynesian Club, Le Jardin Academy
Content: Hawaiʻi knows how to generate its own energy instead of relying on limited resources like oil and gas.
Wind and solar power are developed more to support energy and gain electricity from the Earth.
Cheap Energy from Sun.  No one owns the Sun.  Drives culture based on abundance, not scarcity.

In 150 years from now, the world would be more abandoned.  Humanity would have moved on with its effects to start life on another planet and find more resources outside of Earth and they would find a good renewable energy source and Earth will be able to heal.

People take care of the land. The earth is vibrant, water is clean, and our people thrive. Earth feels safer. All necessary sources of life are local. Energy is clean and abundant. We no longer rely on energy that pollutes our air/waterways. Access to energy is a right, not to be bought or sold for profit. Vehicles run clean energy so no oil spills. Land, animals and humans live together in Harmony.
Oil and gasoline are no longer used, and the need for plastics was eliminated.
Original of Translation: Ya no se usa petróleo o gasolina y se eliminó la necesidad de plásticos.

Content: Our primary energy is solar energy.
Original of Translation: Nuestra energia primaria es la energia solar.
